about: The year of every plan on capstone C2's grid of choices (the choices that change the dispatch): 12 representative days and the two hard weeks, each day committed by a mixed-integer program (gap 1e-6, at most 120 s a solve) and priced by the dispatch linear program with the commitment fixed, solved with engine E2 and HiGHS on 5 November 2026. The page shows each plan's year from here, at once.
